headline: Executive Order sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Labor if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: This order lists which Department of Labor officials would act as Secretary of Labor if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. It is meant to keep the department running without a gap in leadership. No summary was provided, so the exact list of positions is not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are placed in a set order to temporarily take on the Secretary's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 18, 2001; exact effective date not stated in the source material.
